_meta.name: English
top.docNameTitle: File name used when downloading (click to change)
top.openTitle: Open PDF / images (replaces the current document)
top.appendTitle: Append other PDFs or images at the end (merge)
lang.reloadConfirm: Changing the language reloads the page and closes the open document. Continue?
rb.leftTitle: Rotate selected pages 90° to the left
rb.rightTitle: Rotate selected pages 90° to the right
rb.insertTitle: Blank page, pages from another PDF or an image
rb.deleteTitle: Delete selected pages, a range, even or odd pages
rb.extractTitle: Save the chosen pages as a new PDF
rb.splitTitle: Split the document into several PDFs (ZIP)
rb.interleaveTitle: Interleave with the pages of another PDF (front/back scans)
rb.reverseTitle: Reverse page order (of the selection or of all pages)
rb.fitTitle: Fit the content to a paper size (A4, A3…)
rb.imgTitle: Image / logo / stamp over the pages
rb.layersTitle: Show / hide the list of overlays (for editing)
layers.title: Layers
layers.help: Overlays don't change the pages until you download: you can edit, hide or delete them at any time.
layers.empty: No overlays yet. Add one with the buttons below or from the “Overlays” group.
empty.title: Drop one or more PDF files (or images) here
empty.local: Files are processed entirely in your browser – they are never sent to the server.
status.hint: Click = select · Ctrl/Shift+click = multiple · double-click = preview · drag to move
range.title: Select by range
range.help: Separate with commas; “10-” means from 10 to the end.
del.title: Delete pages
ins.title: Insert
ext.title: Extract pages to a new PDF
ext.name: File name
ext.remove: then remove these pages from the current document
il.title: Interleave with another PDF
il.help: Result: 1 from the current document, 1 from the new file, 2 current, 2 new… Useful for front/back pages scanned separately.
il.reverse: take the new file's pages in reverse order (backs scanned in reverse)
il.newFirst: start with the page from the new file
split.title: Split document
split.help: With “by ranges”, separate the files with ; – each group becomes one PDF (e.g. “1-3; 4,6,8; 9-”).
split.help2: The result is downloaded as a ZIP archive. Overlays (numbers, header…) are included.
crop.title: Page format
crop.help: Drag a rectangle on the page (the area that stays visible) or type the margins to remove.
crop.nondestructive: Cropping is non-destructive (it sets the CropBox); content and links stay in the file.
crop.reset: Remove existing crops (on the chosen pages)
crop.fitHelp: The visible content is scaled and centred on the new page. Note: links/form fields on these pages are lost.
ov.numSkip: don't number the first page (counting starts on the second)
ov.text.label: Text
ov.text.help: Variables: {n} page, {total} total pages, {date} today's date, {file} document name.
ov.wm.help: Size 0 = automatic (the text spans ~80% of the page along its direction).
ov.img.current: Current image: {name} (choose another file only if you want to replace it)
ov.noticeOne: The document already has a layer of this type.
ov.noticeMany: The document already has {n} layers of this type.
ov.noticeOr: Or fill in the form below to add another one.
about.local: Everything happens locally, in your browser. Documents are never sent to the server.
pv.hint: Ctrl + mouse wheel = zoom · drag with the mouse to move the page · ← → previous / next page
pv.label: Page {i} of {n}
menu.insPdf: Insert pages from a PDF after…
confirm.open: Open another document? Unsaved changes will be lost.
confirm.close: Close the document? Unsaved changes will be lost.
confirm.deleteAll: ALL pages will be deleted. Continue?
msg.selectFirst: Select one or more pages first.
msg.noFiles: No PDF files or images found.
msg.reversedSel: Reversed the order of the selected pages ({n}).
msg.ovAdded: {type} – added. You can change it at any time from the Layers panel.
warn.encrypted: “{name}” is encrypted. Viewing works, but saved pages may come out blank or corrupted.
warn.interleave: Note: the documents have different page counts ({a} vs {b}); the remaining pages were added at the end.
err.pdflib: pdf-lib cannot read “{name}”: {msg}. Editing this file will not work.
err.noSelScope: No pages selected – choose “all pages” or a range.
err.refPage: The reference page must be between 1 and {n}.
err.zeroMargins: All margins are 0 – drag a rectangle or fill in the margins.
err.fonts: The overlay fonts could not be loaded: {msg}
err.noSuchPage: Page {p} doesn't exist (the document has {n} pages).
err.marginTooBig: The margin is too large for this paper size.
err.marginsPage: The margins are too large for page {n}.
